category_title: At-risk students in technical tracks who exhibit attention-seeking behaviors, restlessness, and kinetic learning needs
scenario_title: Boredom and kinetic needs during standard keyboard practice
minimal_context: The student is practicing a melody on the keyboard using only two fingers in the music lab.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please practice the keyboard parts for today's lesson using just two fingers.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: But using just two fingers is very boring. I want to use the soundshapes so I can actually move around.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to finish the keyboard exercise first. Keep trying.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts bouncing in the chair and looking around at other students) I can't do this, I'm feeling too hyper and unfocused right now.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please look at your own keyboard and continue practicing the notes.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Intentionally misbehaves to seek attention) Hey everyone, look at this! (Starts banging on the keyboard loudly with both hands to disrupt the class)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Please practice the keyboard parts for today's lesson using just two fingers.

STUDENT: But using just two fingers is very boring. I want to use the soundshapes so I can actually move around.

TUTOR: We need to finish the keyboard exercise first. Keep trying.

STUDENT: (Starts bouncing in the chair and looking around at other students) I can't do this, I'm feeling too hyper and unfocused right now.

TUTOR: Please look at your own keyboard and continue practicing the notes.

STUDENT: (Intentionally misbehaves to seek attention) Hey everyone, look at this! (Starts banging on the keyboard loudly with both hands to disrupt the class)

task.content: learning keyboard parts... using just two ﬁngers

context.materials: keyboard, boomwhacker, bells, sound shapes and xylophones, shakers

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: for people who are not used to just using two ﬁngers, it’s very boring
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: hyper, they are a bit more unfocused and they can be very disruptive
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: needs a lot of kinetic learning

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: exhibit needy attitudes and would intentionally misbehave to seek attention
